places.name: Cedar Rock (Pisgah)
places.access: Pisgah NF, no permit. Peregrine closures are posted near the climbers' trail. Butter Gap Trail reroute changed the approach

places.name: Jump Off Rock
places.access: Town of Laurel Park, free, sunrise to sunset, under a CCC agreement. Small lot: leave if full, no big groups

places.name: Looking Glass Rock
places.access: Pisgah NF, no permit. North Face has seasonal peregrine closures (about mid-Jan to mid-Aug). FS 475B is gated seasonally, so check road status

places.name: Rumbling Bald
places.access: Chimney Rock SP. Free climbing permit at the trailhead. Large lot off Boys Camp Rd; if full use other areas. Closed Christmas Day

places.name: Table Rock State Park (SC)
places.access: Park entry fee. Permit box on the climbers' trail behind the White Oaks Pavilion. Designated walls; Walker Buttress closed about Feb 1-Aug 15
